messages:
deploy-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Canary rollout 'release/2026-03-17' -> deployment/inference-edge-canary failing. 4/10 pods CrashLoopBackOff, HPA scaled to 8 due to surge in CPU. Autopause activated. Paging oncall. Logs aggregated at https://logs.redwood.internal/tx/4498761234 :rotating_light:

josh_lee: oncall here, looking. any customer-facing errors?

maya_k: I just joined — seeing high 5xx rates on /v1/generate for canary nodes, trace id sample: 2e7a9f. Pulling pod logs now.

akiko_s: grabbing kube events and pod describe. sending snippets.

akiko_s: ```kubectl -n prod describe pod inference-edge-canary-5f7cc   
Name: inference-edge-canary-5f7cc
State: Waiting
  Reason: CrashLoopBackOff
Last State: Terminated
  Reason: OOMKilled
Events:
  Normal BackOff    2m (x5 over 6m)   kubelet    Back-off restarting failed container
```

samir_r: looks like new image has a memory regression with key-value cache. Reproducer locally: small prompt triggers OOM after kv cache alloc.

josh_lee: @deploy-bot can we pause rollout entirely and route traffic back to stable? Need hotfix or rollback.

deploy-bot: Rollout paused for rollout/release-2026-03-17. Canary traffic reduced to 0% per policy.

maya_k: Customers impacted: several real-time inference customers showed elevated error rates for ~180s during cutover. Emily can you confirm CS noise?

emily_cs: yep — 3 customers opened alerts to support, 1 started automated failover. all reports match 5xx spike from 14:22–14:25 UTC.

samir_r: propose feature-flag kill-switch for the new KV caching optimization: set feature.kv_cache_optim=true -> false. That should avoid the regressed code path without full rollback.

josh_lee: agree. If flag flip doesn't stabilize within 2m, we rollback image to stable tag and notify customers.

maya_k: flipping flag now (LaunchDarkly): `ldctl set feature.kv_cache_optim false --env=prod --scope=canary`

maya_k: :white_check_mark: flag flipped. Watching pods and errors.

akiko_s: pod restart churn decreasing, CPU returning to baseline on canary nodes. No new OOMs in the last 45s.

josh_lee: good. keep 0% traffic to canary until we validate for 15m. samir, create a blocking revert PR for the KV change and attach to incident.

samir_r: created revert PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/5123 - mark as hotfix.

emily_cs: notified affected customers with status update: "We briefly saw elevated errors during tonight's canary rollout; we've paused the rollout and disabled the new caching optimisation while we investigate. No further action required from you."

maya_k: handing over to night oncall @josh_lee -> @akiko_s for long-run monitoring and postmortem. Recording timeline in incident doc.

josh_lee: assigning incident SEV=2 for tracking. Will keep console watch and escalate if errors reappear. Linking to incident page: https://incidents.redwood.internal/INC-2026-03-17-21

sre_bot: Pager duty note appended: incident INC-2026-03-17-21 created; primary oncall: josh_lee; escalation policy: infra-hw.

akiko_s: quick follow-up checks: verifying HPA target metrics and autoscaler cooldowns; investigating why HPA scaled to 8 so quickly — maybe metric threshold too low during rollout.

samir_r: adding to action items: 1) revert KV change (PR 5123), 2) add memory safety checks/limits in kv allocator, 3) tune HPA for rollout spikes, 4) add smoke test for small prompts.

josh_lee: good list. I'll draft the incident timeline and send initial notes to postmortem owner. If no further errors in next 15m we'll close the page as mitigated and follow up with RCA.

emily_cs: closing customer-facing ticket loop after 30m if stabilized.

deploy-bot: NOTE: Rollout currently paused; canary traffic at 0%. Auto-rollback not triggered.

maya_k: last check: 0 new 5xx in last 5m, CPU back to baseline on all canary nodes. I'll keep periodic checks until handoff complete. :thumbsup:

josh_lee: handoff complete to @akiko_s at 14:40 UTC. leaving monitoring.

akiko_s: acknowledged, picking this up. will create postmortem draft tomorrow and schedule RCA.

sre_bot: Incident marked mitigated (temporary mitigation: feature flag disable). Next steps: hotfix revert PR review, postmortem, HPA tuning ticket.
